method: four read-only dux status --json and /proc/pressure samples, ten seconds apart
interpretation: At PSI above the code’s critical I/O threshold (>40%), the daemon paused writes and pending work increased. As PSI fell, it cleared the pause and drained part of the backlog; cumulative overflows and drops stayed unchanged over this 30-second window. The index remained dirty and not caught up, so this is recovery of write processing, not index exactness.
source_threshold: src/guard.rs: Health::level classifies psi_io10 > 40% as Critical; watch loop persists pause state and resumes when pressure recovers.
limitations: One short natural-load episode only; not a controlled fault injection.
Does not establish long-run queue capacity or fix the pre-existing dirty baseline.
No independent filesystem oracle was run.
